To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RFM analysis is very effective in data mining tasks such as clustering, classification and recommendation.

(1) RFM analysis can be used in clustering, classification and rule mining to provide market intelligence; (2) RFM clustering can be used for customer segmentation to find customer segments; (3) Classification rules discovered from the customer segments can be used to predict the future customer behavior; (4) Association rule mining based RFM values can be used to provide better product recommendation.

RFM analysis is an efficient method to analyze customer behavior and to find customer segments for personalization services and that it is a good approach to provide market intelligence by incorporating RFM analysis and various data mining tasks.

the development and implementation of a new approach for market intelligence and product recommendation based on the RFM analysis.

three main objectives: (i) to propose a new three-step method which incorporates RFM analysis into clustering, classification and rule mining tasks; (ii) to discover customer segments using RFM measures and customer demographic variables to find customer segments and (iii) to provide better product recommendation using RFM measures, customer demographic variables and customer transaction data.

developing a new approach to incorporate RFM analysis into three data mining tasks: clustering, classification and associative rule mining, to assist marketing managers in developing better market strategies.
